summary: Cannae Holdings filed an 8-K on July 31, 2026, reporting the sale of its entire interest in Watkins Holdings, LLC (The Watkins Company) to KDSA Investment Partners for $90 million in cash. Cannae had invested $80 million in October 2024; total proceeds including preferred dividends and fees yielded about 1.2x MOIC and nearly 10% IRR. Management characterized this as monetizing a non-core asset within its portfolio transformation strategy, aiming to redeploy capital or return it to shareholders. No advisors or board votes were disclosed. Watch for capital allocation plans—future investments or buybacks—as proceeds are deployed.
